item.g:title: Astraclean Composite Sink Cleaner 500ml – Limescale Remover for Composite, Granite and Quartz Sinks
item.g:description: Astraclean Composite Sink Cleaner brings dull, stained and limescaled composite, granite and quartz sinks back to their original colour and finish without harsh abrasives. Removes limescale and hard-water deposits, eliminates water marks and restores colour to dull or faded composite sinks. Ideal for black, white and coloured sinks and for hard-water areas. Spray on, spread with a soft cloth, sponge or brush, leave for 2–5 minutes, scrub lightly and rinse thoroughly. 1 × 500ml spray bottle. Made in the UK. Not suitable for unsealed natural stone or acid-sensitive surfaces such as marble, terrazzo, enamel or plated metals. Do not mix with bleach or other cleaners. Always read the label before use.
